instructions: Individually reviewed URLs and researcher-written summaries. This file is not a scraper, and the jobs are not automatically revisited every six hours. Records marked withdrawnFromRadar are removal tombstones, not claims that the employer closed the vacancy.

jobs.title: Spanish/English Online Team · Social Media and Content Support
jobs.languageRequirements: Spanish and English customer communication required; Korean not specified
jobs.essentialRequirements: No education or work experience requirement. Must communicate effectively with Spanish- and English-speaking customers. Some social media and customer service duties.
jobs.eligibilityNote: South Korea-based role; English fluency needs individual confirmation. On-site in Seoul, relocation needed from Jeonju.
jobs.researchSummary: Mix of Spanish/English customer support, content review and managing social accounts. No experience requirement; confirm English competence and the customer-facing workload.
jobs.researchNote: Original source marks this listing open until 2026-11-06. Includes non-marketing support duties, not purely a marketing position.

jobs.title: [Anua] Global Seeding Marketing Short-term Intern (Foreign Language Proficiency Required)
jobs.languageRequirements: Spanish accepted as the required second foreign language; English and Korean requirements not stated
jobs.languageFitReason: Spanish is explicitly one of the accepted language options. Other hiring requirements and legal work eligibility still need confirmation.
jobs.essentialRequirements: Skincare market and competitor research, short-form content trend research, seeding topic suggestions, content guides, influencer search/contact/shipment, collaboration communication, and results tracking. One of Spanish, French, or Arabic is accepted; Spanish is explicitly an option. Influencer marketing experience is preferred, not required. No posting date or deadline is displayed.
jobs.eligibilityNote: F-6 is among the preferred visa categories listed by KOWORK, but this does not guarantee work authorization. The page has no visible deadline or post date; current recruitment status is unconfirmed.
jobs.researchSummary: A short-term beauty/SNS marketing internship focused on skincare trend research, short-form content ideas, influencer seeding and campaign result tracking. Spanish is explicitly accepted as one of the required second-language options. Salary is set after interview; Gangnam-gu, Seoul, on-site, weekdays 09:30–18:30.
jobs.researchNote: Original KOWORK page was accessible and inspected on 2026-10-19. No posting date or deadline is visible; confirm current availability with the employer before applying.

jobs.title: Overseas Marketing Intern (Open to Foreign Applicants)
jobs.languageRequirements: Native Spanish accepted; effective communication in Korean or English required; English proficiency unverified
jobs.essentialRequirements: Overseas market research, social-media and travel/beauty trend research, local-language content localization, country-specific social channels, ad copy and keyword research, surveys/interviews and research documentation. The listing requires effective communication in Korean or English and a valid residence permit that allows the internship. New visa applications and visa sponsorship are not available. Full-time internship for 3 or 6 months; Monday–Friday 09:00–18:00.
jobs.eligibilityNote: The listing requires an already-valid Korean residence permit that allows this internship; visa sponsorship and new visa applications are unavailable. Effective communication in Korean or English is required, and English proficiency is unverified. No posting date/deadline is shown, so current availability is unconfirmed.
jobs.researchSummary: A Spanish-relevant overseas marketing internship involving local-market research, content localization, social media, ad copy and consumer research. Listed pay is KRW 2,260,000/month. On-site in Seocho-gu, Seoul; 3- or 6-month internship. Requires an existing eligible residence permit and effective communication in Korean or English.
jobs.researchNote: KOWORK page was accessible and inspected on 2026-10-19, but no posting date or deadline was visible. Confirm the vacancy and work authorization with MyRealTrip before applying.

JOBPLOY lists KRW 3,000,000/month before tax, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, weekdays 10:00–19:00, a 3–6 month internship and possible regular conversion after six months. Detailed language and visa requirements are not provided on the accessible page.
jobs.researchNote: The listing shows registration on 2026-09-30 and deadline 2026-10-31. Detail page inspected on 2026-10-19; requirements are sparse, so confirm directly before applying.

jobs.title: E-commerce Marketing Intern (Intern-to-Hire)
jobs.languageRequirements: Native or fluent Spanish required; fluent Korean preferred but not required; English requirement not specified
jobs.languageFitReason: Spanish fluency is the mandatory language requirement and is a known strength; Korean is preferred but not required, and no English requirement is stated.
jobs.essentialRequirements: Create marketing emails and promotional content for Instagram and TikTok. Native or fluent Spanish and strong written Spanish are required. Basic social-media knowledge, interest in e-commerce/branding and willingness to learn are required. Korean, email marketing tools, Shopify, design tools and previous social-media content experience are listed as preferred or nice-to-have, not mandatory. Full-time paid 3-month internship; Monday–Friday 09:00–18:00; hybrid with one or two office meetings per week.
jobs.eligibilityNote: KOWORK says applicants must already be Korea residents and legally eligible to work full-time. E-7 sponsorship appears in the benefits section, but confirm whether it applies to this internship. Korean is preferred, not required. No posting date/deadline is displayed; current availability is unconfirmed.
jobs.researchSummary: Strong Spanish-language marketing fit: creates marketing emails and Instagram/TikTok promotions. Spanish fluency is required; Korean is preferred but not mandatory; prior social-media, Shopify, email-marketing and design experience are nice-to-have rather than required. Paid 3-month internship at KRW 2.5 million/month before tax, hybrid with regular office meetings in Hanam; potential full-time conversion.
jobs.researchNote: KOWORK page accessible and inspected on 2026-10-19. No post date/deadline shown; verify the opening and work authorization with the employer.

jobs.title: [Video Content Planning, Spanish required] Video Planning and Script Writing
jobs.languageRequirements: Spanish proficiency required; English required; Korean preferred; English proficiency unverified
jobs.essentialRequirements: Plan and script short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts; analyze trends and performance; create storytelling-based scenarios. Spanish proficiency and English are required, Korean is preferred. Experience in viral video planning or marketing/branding is requested, but no minimum years are stated. E-7 visa sponsorship is listed.
jobs.eligibilityNote: Stretch role for a marketing beginner: the employer requests experience in viral-video planning or marketing/branding, and English is required but unverified. E-7 sponsorship is listed but eligibility must be confirmed. No posting date/deadline is visible; availability is unconfirmed.
jobs.researchSummary: Spanish-related short-form video planning and scriptwriting for TikTok, Reels and YouTube Shorts. Listed salary is KRW 30 million/year, negotiable; on-site in Hanam, weekdays 09:00–18:00. English is required, Korean preferred, and relevant content/marketing experience is requested, so this is a lower-priority stretch lead.
jobs.researchNote: KOWORK page accessible and inspected on 2026-10-19. No posting date/deadline shown; confirm current hiring status before applying.

jobs.title: Short-Form Content Creator (Part-Time / Full-Time)
jobs.languageRequirements: English-speaking work environment; English proficiency not quantified; Spanish not required
jobs.essentialRequirements: Produce daily short-form videos for TikTok Shop, TikTok and Instagram Reels. The company emphasizes viral hooks, rapid execution and creative performance. Minimum commitment is 15 hours per week. No minimum years of experience are stated, but short-form video creation ability is important. The listing says in-house attendance in Itaewon is required despite the Hybrid label. E-6 sponsorship may be available to qualified candidates after trials.
jobs.eligibilityNote: Adjacent content opportunity, not Spanish-specific. The environment is English-speaking and English ability is unverified. Must commute to Itaewon; sponsorship is only described as possible for qualified candidates after trials. No pay, posting date or deadline is listed, so availability is unconfirmed.
jobs.researchSummary: Freelance part-time/full-time short-form content creator for Korean skincare e-commerce, producing daily TikTok and Reels videos. Minimum 15 hours/week; office attendance in Itaewon is required despite the Hybrid label. Pay and deadline are not listed. English-speaking environment; visa sponsorship may be available after trials for qualified candidates.
jobs.researchNote: KOWORK page accessible and inspected on 2026-10-19. No posting date/deadline shown; video-production fit and current availability require confirmation.

jobs.title: StemOn Marketing and Sales Headquarters Recruitment (German/Spanish)
jobs.languageRequirements: German/Spanish communication; fluent English required; English proficiency unverified
jobs.languageFitReason: The source writes German/Spanish without clarifying whether either language is accepted or both are required; fluent English is required but unverified.
jobs.essentialRequirements: Product marketing and sales, international PR, and planning/management for domestic and international conferences or exhibitions. The listing says ability to communicate in German/Spanish, fluent English, and a bachelor's degree or higher are required. Entry-level and experienced candidates are mentioned. E-7 visa holder or eligibility is required; business travel may be involved.
jobs.eligibilityNote: Lower-priority lead: fluent English and a bachelor's degree are mandatory, and the page does not clarify whether German/Spanish means either language or both. English ability and E-7 eligibility must be confirmed. No posting date/deadline is shown; current availability is unconfirmed.
jobs.researchSummary: Full-time product marketing/sales and international PR for a bio/pharmaceutical company, including conference and exhibition work. On-site in Seongnam, weekdays 09:00–18:00; salary not listed. Fluent English and a bachelor's degree are required; the German/Spanish language wording is ambiguous. Entry-level candidates are mentioned, but the role is a stretch if English or education requirements are not met.
jobs.researchNote: KOWORK page accessible and inspected on 2026-10-19. No posting date/deadline shown; confirm whether Spanish alone is accepted and whether the role is still open.

jobs.title: [SNOW] Latin America Content Marketing Intern
jobs.languageRequirements: Native-level Spanish required; Korean and English levels not specified on the original vacancy
jobs.languageFitReason: Native Spanish meets the stated language criterion; video/image-editing skills and practical interview language remain unverified.
jobs.essentialRequirements: Native-level Latin American Spanish, strong video/image editing skills (e.g., Photoshop and Premiere Pro), proven short-form content creation, full-time availability for approximately three months (Mon–Fri 10:00–19:00), and availability for interviews October 26–28 and a November 9 start. Duties cover Spanish-speaking Latin American social research, content planning assistance, and influencer communication.
jobs.eligibilityNote: Official SNOW careers page lists applications through October 22, 2026 at 23:59. Spanish is a direct match, but skilled editing/short-form production is mandatory and unverified. English/Korean and foreign-national employment eligibility are not expressly stated. On-site in Seongnam; commute/relocation needs consideration.
jobs.researchSummary: Three-month full-time entry-level marketing internship supporting Latin American Spanish-language social listening, short-form content and influencer communication for SNOW photo/video apps. The company requires strong practical Photoshop/Premiere-type editing and short-form creation skills; pay is not stated. Company application deadline: October 22, 2026, 23:59 Korean time.
jobs.researchNote: Official individual SNOW recruiting page inspected October 19, 2026. The page calls October 13 the application-period start, not the proven posting date; postedAt left unknown. Closing date is expressly listed and the role appears on the official job list.

jobs.title: [SNOW] Latin America (Spanish-speaking) Content Marketer, Fixed-term
jobs.languageRequirements: Spanish-language communication with Latin American audiences required; Korean/English requirements not stated
jobs.languageFitReason: Spanish-language market experience aligns, but professional-grade editing and independently producing short-form content are essential and unverified.
jobs.essentialRequirements: Plan and execute Latin American campaigns for EPIK, create video/image assets, monitor Spanish-language trends, and track campaign performance. Must communicate fluently with Spanish-speaking audiences, be proficient with Photoshop/Premiere/CapCut-type image and video tools, produce high-quality short-form content, and follow social trends. Six-month fixed-term contract with possible renewal, no planned permanent conversion.
jobs.eligibilityNote: Company career vacancy lists an extended application deadline of October 21, 2026 at 23:59. Contract role with substantial content production responsibility, beyond beginner marketing experience. Foreign-national eligibility and Korean/English needs are unstated; editing portfolio and commute to Seongnam should be checked.
jobs.researchSummary: Six-month contract creating and running Latin American Spanish-language EPIK content campaigns: campaign themes/messages, short-form videos/images, performance monitoring and trend research. The company explicitly requires strong editing and content-creation skills and does not plan permanent conversion. Pay is not shown.
jobs.researchNote: Individual official SNOW careers result checked October 19, 2026; source notes the application window was extended October 13 and now closes October 21. September 29 is the application-period start, not necessarily the posting date.

jobs.title: Spanish-speaking On-camera YouTube Presenter (Construction Demonstration)
jobs.languageRequirements: Native Spanish required and fluent spoken English for video presentations; Korean explicitly not required
jobs.languageFitReason: Spanish is a match and Korean is not required, but fluent on-camera English is explicitly required and remains unverified.
jobs.essentialRequirements: Appear in a YouTube video showing a construction-material installation, deliver English-language explanations from provided scripts, and be comfortable speaking on camera. Native Spanish is requested despite English being the video language. Preferred age wording is inconsistent (20–40 versus late-20s to late-40s). Filming hours are negotiable; the employer says travel expenses are separate for participants outside Daejeon.
jobs.eligibilityNote: No Korean required; on-camera English and suitability for the employer's filming brief require direct confirmation. Daejeon is outside Jeonju and the actual number of paid filming hours is not stated. Posting date, deadline, actual vacancy and visa work eligibility are unconfirmed.
jobs.researchSummary: One-off/part-time video appearance explaining construction-material installation in English from supplied scripts. Native Spanish is requested and Korean is explicitly not required. On-site filming in Daejeon with separate travel expenses for outside participants. The page lists KRW 35,000/hour, but does not state total guaranteed hours.
jobs.researchNote: KOWORK individual posting accessed October 19, 2026. No publication date or application deadline available and English proficiency is not confirmed; do not treat this as guaranteed regular employment.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Intern (International Tourism Content)
jobs.languageRequirements: Strong working English is required; Korean or Japanese is preferred, Spanish is not specifically requested
jobs.essentialRequirements: Support social-media content, short ad copy, creator/KOL research, digital campaign setup and results tracking for overseas visitors. Interest in tourism, marketing, short-form content and spreadsheets required; no years of marketing work are specified. Korean is preferred. Role detail says a 3-month part-time internship 2–3 days/week, Seoul/hybrid, pay negotiable, but the page header says full-time and the stated July–August 2026 start date has passed.
jobs.eligibilityNote: Company career index still labels the internship HIRING and shows an application form, yet the role description states a July–August 2026 start; recruitment status and new start date must be reconfirmed. Strong English is mandatory but unverified, and the target audience is US/SE Asia rather than Spanish-speaking markets. Working hours conflict between header and details.
jobs.researchSummary: Company-listed internship assisting a tourism startup with short-form posts, influencer research, ad campaigns, spreadsheets and basic KPI tracking; beginner-friendly duties and Korean only preferred. Listed as Seoul/hybrid and paid by negotiation, but strong English is required. The apparent July–August start date is already past, so confirm this is actually still recruiting.
jobs.researchNote: Official company careers index and individual application page checked October 19, 2026. The index reads HIRING while the start date in the role description is in the past; no reliable posting date/deadline. Contract schedule is inconsistent on source.
